mapper.select: SELECT id,customer_code code,customer_name name FROM bike_customer WHERE status='ENABLED' AND (customer_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY customer_code,id LIMIT 200

SELECT id,agent_code code,agent_name name FROM bike_agent WHERE status='ENABLED' AND (agent_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR agent_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY agent_code,id LIMIT 200

SELECT s.id,s.model_id modelId,s.sku_code skuCode,s.product_name productName,s.specification,s.enabled FROM bike_production_sku s JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=s.model_id WHERE s.enabled=1 AND m.enabled=1 AND (s.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY s.sku_code,s.id LIMIT 200

SELECT o.id,o.order_no orderNo,o.customer_id customerId,o.agent_id agentId,o.status, i.product_model_id modelId,i.ordered_qty quantity FROM bike_sales_order o JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING','CONFIRMED') AND i.shipped_qty=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi p WHERE p.source_order_id=o.id) AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id,p.pi_no,p.revision,p.series_id,p.previous_revision_id,p.customer_id,p.customer_code,p.customer_name, p.agent_id,a.agent_name,p.source_order_id,p.trade_type,p.currency_code,p.status, p.payment_status,p.release_status,p.planned_ship_date,p.subtotal,p.discount_amount, reservation_status, p.tax_amount,p.freight_amount,p.other_fee_amount,p.total_amount,p.deposit_required_amount,p.shipment_required_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(x.amount) FROM bike_pi_payment x JOIN bike_pi px ON px.id=x.pi_id WHERE (px.series_id=p.series_id OR (px.series_id IS NULL AND p.series_id IS NULL AND px.id=p.id)) AND x.status='CONFIRMED'),0) paid_amount, p.document_snapshot document_json,p.remark,p.released_at,p.created_at,p.updated_at FROM bike_pi p LEFT JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=p.agent_id LEFT JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=p.source_order_id LEFT JOIN bike_order_reservation r ON r.order_id=o.id

where.if: AND (p.pi_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_pi(pi_no,revision,customer_id,customer_code,customer_name,agent_id,source_order_id, trade_type,currency_code,status,payment_status,release_status,planned_ship_date,subtotal, discount_amount,tax_amount,freight_amount,total_amount,deposit_required_amount, shipment_required_amount,document_snapshot,remark,created_by,other_fee_amount) SELECT #{piNo},1,c.id,c.customer_code,c.customer_name,#{agentId},#{request.sourceOrderId}, #{tradeType},#{currencyCode},'DRAFT','UNPAID','BLOCKED',#{request.plannedShipDate},#{subtotal}, #{discountAmount},#{taxAmount},#{freightAmount},#{totalAmount},#{depositRequiredAmount}, #{shipmentRequiredAmount},#{documentJson},#{request.remark},#{createdBy},COALESCE(#{request.otherFeeAmount},0) FROM bike_customer c WHERE c.id=#{request.customerId} AND c.status='ENABLED'
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_pi p JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id=#{request.customerId} AND c.status='ENABLED' SET p.customer_id=c.id,p.customer_code=c.customer_code,p.customer_name=c.customer_name, p.agent_id=#{agentId},p.trade_type=#{tradeType},p.currency_code=#{currencyCode}, p.planned_ship_date=#{request.plannedShipDate},p.subtotal=#{subtotal},p.discount_amount=#{discountAmount}, p.tax_amount=#{taxAmount},p.freight_amount=#{freightAmount},p.total_amount=#{totalAmount}, p.deposit_required_amount=#{depositRequiredAmount},p.shipment_required_amount=#{shipmentRequiredAmount}, p.document_snapshot=#{documentJson},p.remark=#{request.remark},p.other_fee_amount=COALESCE(#{request.otherFeeAmount},0) WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.status='DRAFT'

AND shipment_required_amount IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT q.paid FROM (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount),0) paid FROM bike_pi_payment pay JOIN bike_pi p0 ON p0.id=pay.pi_id JOIN bike_pi p1 ON (p1.series_id=p0.series_id OR (p1.series_id IS NULL AND p0.series_id IS NULL AND p1.id=p0.id)) WHERE p1.id=#{id} AND pay.status='CONFIRMED') q) >= shipment_required_amount
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount),0) FROM bike_pi_payment pay JOIN bike_pi p0 ON p0.id=pay.pi_id JOIN bike_pi p1 ON (p1.series_id=p0.series_id OR (p1.series_id IS NULL AND p0.series_id IS NULL AND p1.id=p0.id)) WHERE p1.id=#{piId} AND pay.status='CONFIRMED' FOR UPDATE
